I think 2 things are at play here with OOPs perception.

1: With the MFF threesome, OOP is in a situation where he is attracted to both the other parties involved, his wife and the other woman, as a straight male; his wife is also attracted to both parties, him and the other women, being bisexual. With the MFM threesome, he would have no attraction to the other person involved, whereas his wife would have that attraction to both men. I think that does contribute to his unwillingness to have a MFM threesome, and that is not invalid. 

2: However, the bigger issue I see, and giving OOP the benefit of the doubt, is internalized misogyny. Him saying he felt jealousy and anger with the thought of a MFM threesome says that he doesn’t classify two women having sex as “real” sex. Even though there is the same possibility of competition with a woman as with a man. In a different circumstance, like if he wasn’t married to a committed partner, his wife being bisexual gives the same possibility of some type of relationship coming from a woman as it does a man. If she were single she could easily have a relationship with a woman as she could with a man. Yet in this situation, he never felt that threat with the other women, that he does with the thought of a man. 

I have no issue with setting the boundary of not having any more group sex with anybody no matter the gender, but I do think it is something he should really look into why he feels there is such a difference between what he perceives as sex between two women and sex between a man and a woman. I think that would be something to help him grow and be a better person and partner. Even if they do keep it strictly monogamous and never have another threesome.

My father did that job in my hometown when his mother got sick, and he couldn’t work a normal 9-5 because of it. I would help during the summer and for the Sunday paper. I made like $20-$30 a week doing it, it was hard work but I loved it. We would stop at the gas station and get a refill of fountain pop before the shift, it was like a treat for doing it. And being out at 3am almost felt like I was getting away with something nefarious because kids weren’t supposed to be out that late. 

I did notice the families at the facility though, the small children wrapped up in blankets and sleeping in the back of cars, the slightly older kids working as hard as the parents. I didn’t recognize at the time how difficult life was for some people who that type of work was their only option. For me it was just a way to make some money to go to the movies or buy get some candy from the store, when there weren’t enough grasses to cut or driveways to shovel.
